admissible-set-periodicity.last_note: Closed (HS) via SP: every pair of terms shares a prime <= a1, proved by minimal-counterexample descent using bridge (star)/G3, Step B, compression witness C. Full solve, no gaps.
admissible-set-periodicity.summary: Static reformulation: sequence enumerates A={x:gcd(x,a_i)>1 ∀i}; finite essential prime set S makes A exactly ∏S-periodic down to a_1 (exactness free).

essential-prime-counting.last_note: Same reduction (Lemmas A–D) sound; interval-occupancy Σ1/p² gives rigorous bad-pair density bound but cannot exclude sparse disjoint essential families — MCL finiteness still open, needs greedy minimality.
essential-prime-counting.summary: Headline the finiteness crux via explicit sieve/interval-occupancy counting (aimo-0447): large primes are sole connectors only finitely often ⇒ finite S ⇒ CRT periodicity down to a_1.

finite-state-reversible.summary: Dynamical: orbit of deterministic map on finite state (a_n mod L + bounded S-pattern window); pigeonhole ⇒ eventual periodicity, reversibility (aimo-0514) ⇒ exact from n=1.

profile-class-recruitment.last_note: Steps B,2,3,4a rigorous: (HS) reduced to (REC) for both-infinite disjoint-profile types; (REC) recruitment-termination honestly left as explicit open gap. Superseded by admissible-set-periodicity solve.
profile-class-recruitment.summary: Finite S₀-profile alphabet + connector size bound (gap|difference) + recruitment monovariant over disjoint-profile obligation class-pairs; different framing of (HS), open termination nucleus.
